about: Which URLs in a line of an answer the chat draws as links, the same in both CLIs (2026-09-25). A bare URL ends at a space, a closing bracket, an angle bracket, a quote or a backtick, and not on punctuation; inside inline code or emphasis it stays text. Python: tests/cli/test_bare_urls.py (a paragraph, or a list item when block is 'bullet'); TypeScript: tests/unit/cli/bare-urls.test.ts (inline() on the text).
